name: How long does a typical large-scale home remodel take with AKN Design Group?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical large-scale home remodel take with AKN Design Group?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a large-scale home remodel can vary significantly based on the project's scope, structural changes, and material selections. While we've successfully completed over 10,000 jobs, a whole-home renovation, for instance, might range from several months to over a year. Factors influencing the timeline include permitting coordination, material lead times, and the complexity of customized renovations like adding a primary suite or redefining an entire floor plan. We prioritize clear communication and provide upfront estimates and scheduling transparency to manage expectations effectively throughout the process.
acceptedAnswer.description: Project duration varies based on scope and materials, typically ranging from several months to over a year for whole-home remodels. Factors include permitting, material lead times, and project complexity.
